theme: DNS resolution failure after provider migration

0: 04:05 UTC: missing DNS record is manually added and propagates.
auth-service's internal hostname is resolved via the internal DNS zone.
Diff the automated service inventory against the manual one used in this migration, and confirm zero discrepancies before the next migration phase.
1: 03:12 UTC: notification-service begins failing DNS resolution.
2: user-service, which also calls auth-service, was unaffected because it caches DNS results for 30 minutes.
100% of push and email notifications failed to send between 03:12 and 04:05 UTC.
3: A DNS provider migration left an internal service record unmigrated, causing notification-service to fail resolving auth-service's internal hostname.
The missing DNS record was manually added to the new provider at 03:58 UTC.
4: notification-service depends on auth-service to validate delivery tokens.
The DNS migration runbook's service inventory did not include auth-service.internal.
5: Generate the DNS migration service inventory automatically from service-discovery records instead of a manually maintained list.
notification-service error logs show 'failed to resolve host' beginning 03:12 UTC.
6: Approximately 190,000 notifications were queued and delayed.
The DNS migration runbook has caused two prior partial outages from incomplete service inventories.
7: DNS query logs show NXDOMAIN responses for auth-service.internal starting 03:12 UTC.
Queued notifications were replayed starting 04:10 UTC.
